core.title: Name every product capability URN capability:{kebab-case-name}, built via the stack's capability-URN builder
core.given: A product capability URN is being assigned or constructed — in a plan artifact, manifest, spec, implementation code or generation code, by any author.
core.when: You create, rename or build the product capability's URN.
core.then: Build the product capability URN through the stack's designated capability-URN construction construct (profile key urn.builder#builder_capability) so it is capability:{kebab-case-name}, matching the product capability URN shape (profile key urn.capability).
prefer: A verb-object slug that names what the product capability does (e.g. resolve-dilemmas, commit-state).
Valid forms as in the source: capability:resolve-dilemmas, capability:burn-timebank, capability:manage-users.
avoid: Hand-assembling the product capability URN string instead of using the stack's designated capability-URN builder (urn.builder#builder_capability).
Uppercase, underscores, spaces, dots or a leading digit/hyphen in the name part.
Noun-only or vague slugs when a verb-object slug fits.
core.why: Feature URNs, user/system flows and slug/dirname conversion all derive from the product capability URN, so a single predictable kebab grammar built through one construction path keeps references and generated paths consistent.
evidence: Every declared product capability URN matches the product capability URN shape (urn.capability).
Product capability URNs constructed in code or generated artifacts are produced via the stack's designated capability-URN builder (urn.builder#builder_capability), not hand-assembled strings.
verification: Hard check: every declared product capability URN is matched against the profile's product capability URN shape (urn.capability); a mismatch is a finding. The verb-object slug form is a preference, not a hard failure.

Construction check: a product capability URN constructed in code or in a generated artifact must come from the stack's capability-URN builder (urn.builder#builder_capability); a hand-built product capability URN string literal at a construction site is a finding.
The check accepts the known-valid examples capability:resolve-dilemmas, capability:burn-timebank, capability:manage-users.

Detecting the change-based activation requires a diff-level observer that extracts added/changed product capability URN values and new capability-URN construction sites (string literals vs designated-builder calls); mere references to an existing, unchanged product capability URN are not findings.

values: product capability URN builder (profile key urn.builder#builder_capability)
any file declaring a product capability URN
product capability URN constructed/assigned in code or generator

fires: A new product capability manifest is authored and its URN assigned
An existing product capability is renamed and its URN changes
A plan artifact or spec declares a new product capability URN
Implementation or generation code assigns or constructs a new product capability URN
doesNotFire: Editing a product capability's plan artifacts (e.g. DESIRED OUTCOMES) or acceptances without touching its URN
Naming a feature, user/system flow or artifact URN (governed by their own naming conventions)
Code or docs that only reference an existing, unchanged product capability URN

profileRequirements.meaning: The exact product capability URN shape (grammar) that every declared or constructed product capability URN must match; the core's then/evidence/verification refer to it generically.

The stack's designated construct by which code builds a product capability URN; product capability URNs constructed in code or generated artifacts must be produced through it, never hand-assembled strings.

neutralityNotes: 'product capability' and the capability:{kebab-case-name} scheme are treated as stack-neutral ATDD artifact concepts (the profile vocabulary itself parameterizes urn.<artifact> and layout.capability_dir over product capability), so the core names the product capability URN directly while the exact pattern is carried by urn.capability. The Bun 'built via URNBuilder.capability' obligation is generalized to 'built via the stack's designated capability-URN construction construct' through the proposed key urn.builder#builder_capability; with the Bun profile value URNBuilder.capability the obligation is identical. The rule's term id (capability_urn_pattern) and the builder's concrete API name remain realization details (bunOnly).
